We evaluate editing performance using standard metrics introduced by . Edit Success Rate (ESR) measures how often the LLM outputs the correct edited object (target_new); Retention Rate (RR) measures whether the original object (target_true) is preserved on unrelated neighborhood prompts; and Paraphrase Consistency (PC) checks agreement on paraphrased in-scope prompts.
